title: FigureSpec

x-hakowan-conventions.attribute_reference: Channel, texture, and transform attribute inputs reference named fields inside the selected geometry source.
x-hakowan-conventions.channel_composition: Each channel key is a semantic slot. Along a root-to-leaf path, the first value for a slot wins; unrelated slots compose.
x-hakowan-conventions.config: Invocation-time renderer policy; an explicit Config overrides all Figure-derived rendering configuration.
x-hakowan-conventions.figure: Portable visualization intent serialized as FigureSpec.
x-hakowan-conventions.scalar_field: To color geometry by a scalar attribute, use a diffuse material whose reflectance is a scalar_field texture. Supply only data.name for the default inferred domain, viridis colormap, and automatic legend.
